description: Na₂W₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.95 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-33°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.22 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-33°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.10 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃W trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and two equivalent W atoms to form distorted ONa₃W₂ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃W₂ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent ONa₂W₂ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃W₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂W₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two W atoms to form distorted ONa₂W₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃W₂ square pyramids, corners with three ONa₃W tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃W trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃W₂ square pyramids.
